about: The motion layer (SPEC 23, Motion): how a body of ours walks on its legs and carries its weight, by rig id. A body listed here plants its feet on the ground and steps them in a gait by two-bone IK (gait), and gets the body features named in body. A body not listed moves as before. Distances in model pixels unless noted; strides, reach and settle in blocks; times in seconds; angles in radians except fan (degrees).
